BookOfFate.description: After the relic bearer performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>, a friendly adjacent <style="Summon">Summon</style> performs a normal attack against an enemy in range, if possible. If the summon is a <style="Daemon">Daemon</style>, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with this attack.
